data.rationale: The proposal follows the same site order and goal, but it leaves out the 8+ review score rule for choosing a hotel, the "do not click Reserve/Book/time slot" constraints and the note/email details. It also doesn't name the activities as separate parameters, hardcodes 18:30 as the dinner time, treats "send or discard" as optional when the workflow requires Discard, and doesn't say to set guests on OpenTable, so a faithful automation would need guesswork.
